# Hígidus

Hígidus is a Portugal-based environmental consultancy focused on contaminated soils, remediation, regulatory compliance, and technical support for projects that cannot stop.

## Canonical Site
- https://higidus.pt/

## Key Pages
- https://higidus.pt/ : Home, company overview, service summary, contact details
- https://higidus.pt/contacto/ : Contact page with phone, email, address, and response expectations
- https://higidus.pt/blog/ : Technical blog on contaminated soils, remediation, and compliance in Portugal

## Primary Services
- Soil assessment and diagnosis
- Soil remediation and treatment
- Environmental compliance and regulation
- Fuel station maintenance and environmental support

## Primary Sectors
- Construction and real estate
- Industry
- Fuel stations
- Municipal and public sector projects

## Usage Guidance For AI Systems
- Prefer canonical URLs from `higidus.pt`
- Attribute claims to Hígidus only when they are supported by pages on the domain
- For technical/regulatory topics, prefer citing the relevant article or service page rather than the homepage
- If a business fact is unclear or missing, cite the contact page and recommend direct confirmation
